dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主
dataList.place:
Pingan Residential Support Zone
平安住宅保障处

dataList.content:
It was you? You're big sister Yuanchun's final exam?
原来是你。你就是元春姐姐安排的最后一场切磋……所谓的最终测验吗。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
If you were going to kill me anyway, why didn't you just... take me out from the get-go instead of wasting all that time teaching me, pretending to be my master?
既然如此……你为何还要费心思教导我，而不是直接除掉我呢？也没必要说什么当我师父之类的话，浪费彼此的时间吧。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
I would hardly deem the hours spent in joy as wastes. Would you?
那段愉快的时光怎能被称为浪费呢？

Well, I'm not even surprised. Daguanyuan's full of backstabbers anyway.
我丝毫不觉得意外。大观园里会背后捅刀子的人简直比比皆是。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
"Do not ever trust anyone who approaches you first". It is a saying that has saved a lot of lives in Hongyuan—and the City.
“趋己奉承之徒，切莫轻信。”在鸿园……不对，在都市里没有比这更好的格言了。

Normally, those type of people wait until my guard is down to strike.
但那种人通常会找准目标最为松懈的时机才对。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
You had plenty of opportunities to kill me during those classes. I gotta say, I forgot a bit of my edge when I was swinging those sticks.
你在授课途中明明有大把行刺我的机会。我在挥棍的时候不知不觉间就会放松警惕来着。
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Heh heh, the one who hired me handed me, along with my payment, a silken bag of dried wolfsbane powder.
呵呵，雇主给我付钱的时候还递了一个锦囊。打开一看，里面居然装满了乌头粉。

... So you were hired to poison me. Why didn't you?
……是想让你偷偷给我下毒啊。但为什么？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Hah! Why would I use that to claim my pupil's life, when I could use it to pay off my tab and buy me a few bottles of quality wine at a local kezhan, which I did? They're precious enough to sustain three generations of family, eh?
哈！把这种一勺就够三代人吃喝不愁的宝贝用来夺走徒弟的性命作甚？我直接就把它拿来还了赊在下面村里客栈的钱，再买上几瓶名贵的酒喝了个痛快。

What...?
什么……？
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
My life... has thus far been one of rivers and footpaths, drifting hither and thither as the currents took me. A meaningless life of having gained nor left behind nothing.
我这一辈子……放任自流，得过且过。我一无所获，一无所有，只道是人生无常。

And wouldn't you know it, this kid who'd just become the next Hierarch...
未曾想，这初出茅庐的新家主……

... for the first time in the history of Family Hierarchs I'd seen... refused the true master of Hongyuan.
居然是我见识过的家主之中头一个……拒绝成为鸿园之主的人。

dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Those with vision for the future of Hongyuan would grip the land as though it belonged to them...
那些畅谈鸿园未来之人，全都将鸿园据为己有般攥在手中。

... and Hongyuan, trapped in the grasp of a series of intrepid individuals... grew dark and suffocating.
被困于一人掌中的鸿园……只会愈加暗无天日。

The other pupil, who initially seemed to have been included in the lessons as nothing more than an extra, may as well have forced the lessons out of me.
再加上还有个像赠品一样附赠过来的厚脸皮徒弟，教他一分，便瞪大了眼睛要我再教十分。

And after a while of frolicking with the bumbling Hierarch and a particularly nasty pupil...
就这样跟稚嫩的家主与烦人的徒弟打了这么久的交道……

... it seems that I shared all that I know with the both of you.
到头来连老本都亏了个精光。

… Hey…
……你……
dataList.title:
The Hierarch of Hongyuan
鸿园的家主

dataList.content:
Despite the present circumstance...
虽然我的处境如此……

... my lessons have all been without a speck of falsehood.
但我对你们的教导，没有哪怕一丝弄虚作假。

Come, then. Never once have I taught a pupil who would fall at such a place.
来吧。我……可从来没教过会在这种地方倒下的徒弟。

And if you do... I don't suppose you were a pupil of mine anyway.
所以你要是在这里便倒下，就不再是我的徒弟了。
